name: Rui
source:
The game’s main heroine.
A skilled healer and Souya’s wife.
She is the popular beauty of the village, equally loved by everyone.
Cheerful and kind, she greatly respects her husband.
Rui always dreamed of having a child, and Shion’s arrival granted her the perfect chance to finally channel all of her motherly love towards someone.
As the village healer, Rui is a skilled user of restorative magic… although she lacks a partner who can appropriately replenish her mana.
